mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) can potentiate metoprolol's effects and increase risk of ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity; both drugs require renal elimination and amikacin may impair renal function, increasing metoprolol accumulation.
action: Monitor renal function, blood pressure, and heart rate closely; adjust metoprolol dosing if renal impairment develops; assess for signs of ototoxicity.
